c74object.name: evi_ptr
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_ptr.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_ptr.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
3rd order PTR ('Polynomial Transition Region') Oscillators. In evieve these are better than the polyblep 2-point, but not as good as the polyblep 4-point.

entry.name: ptr3_saw ( )
entry.description:
High quality classic Saw Oascillator
In 1: type=input: p, Phase 0..1
In 2: type=input: T0, Hz / samplerate
In 3: type=input: P0, samplerate / Hz
Return 1: Saw, Saw oscillator

entry.name: ptr3_rect ( )
entry.description:
High quality classic Rect Oascillator with PWM
In 1: type=input: p, Phase 0..1
In 2: type=input: T0, Hz / samplerate
In 3: type=input: P0, samplerate / Hz
In 4: type=input: w, PWM 0..1
Return 1: Rect, Rect oscillator
